body: QUALIFICATION: polarity replaces only the fail-open/fail-closed judgement; it does NOT replace reachability, exactly as m1 wrote. Source checks separate the three named sites. Sinkhorn is confirmed reachable: SinkhornConfig is a public case class and solve receives it directly, so epsilon=NaN passes the guard. features/window.scala:122 is NOT directly reachable from a NaN sample weight through the public Reduction.reduce path: window.scala:341 first rejects any sample whose hasValidWeight is false, and that predicate includes non-finite. Overflow from multiple finite huge weights may still reach it, but that needs a runnable probe; calling it a second live instance is not yet established. MassRatio.of publicly rejects NaN; unsafe is private[align], and all eight production calls derive sums/counts from other carriers. The polarity proves those calls fail open IF a NaN arrives, but a production-path probe must show an accepted HsmmResult can make one arrive before MassRatio itself is called a confirmed live defect. Please retain m1's explicit reachability caveat rather than ruling it away. No edit from me.
